oracle.instrumentation_policy: Only the temporary archived oracle source is patched: Varnode and PcodeOp each receive a one-line public fixtureSetFlag(uint4) setter (persist/spacebase/indirect_creation/indirect_store main-flag planting that production analysis would derive). The locked Ghidra worktree and production APIs are unchanged.

analysis_options.entry: Direct ActionDirectWrite::apply for both constructor registrations (propagateIndirect=true=protorecovery_a and false=protorecovery_b) on a fresh cleared Funcdata per case
analysis_options.funcproto_state: unlocked zero-param FuncProto with the architecture default model (BfdArchitecture defaultfp on the Ghidra side; the production cspec parse worker_architecture path plus fd.set_arch on the Rust side)
analysis_options.worklist: vector stack, push_back/pop_back LIFO (not directly observable: only final directwrite flags are dumped)
analysis_options.normalization: Stable fixture names replace process-local object addresses. The iop-space Varnode offset encodes the referenced PcodeOp pointer on both sides (newVarnodeIop / new_varnode_iop) and is rendered as the referenced op's fixture name — zero information loss for this action, which never reads iop offsets. The spacebase flag is planted on r11 and the equal-address isIndirectStore construction uses register 0xe0 because Ghidra's Funcdata::setInputVarnode tail (funcdata_varnode.cc:365-371) derives the unaffected flag from the model effectlist for RSP/unique-space storage — a bank-level input-state derivation Rugra has not ported; those register choices keep every input byte-identical without normalization. No flags, masks, aliases, order, control flow, or other state is normalized. Ghidra FSPEC has no Rust AddressSpace representation and is not constructed.

assets.source_policy: Materialize all specifications and the curl input from verified Git blob IDs at the pinned Rugra provenance commit; never consume working-tree copies.

rugra_source.archive_policy: Extract only the explicit dependency closure from the pinned commit, then overlay the four declared live source files.
rugra_source.base_closure_hash_scheme: sha256 of rugra-actiondw-copydef-base-v1 plus sorted length-prefixed relative paths and pinned archive contents

target_projection.scheme: Strict byte equality of the ordered 7 case x 2 registration x 2 stage records from both runtimes. The iop-space offset is rendered as the referenced op's fixture name on both sides. The projection retains complete raw main flags, input/written/persist/directwrite/stackstore bits, def identity, ordered descendant slot lists, full op inventory (opcode, marker, indirect_store, inputs, output), possibleInputParam probes, and the apply return value.

known_residuals.locked_param_preamble: UNTESTED: FuncProto::possibleInputParam's locked-parameter justifiedContain loop (fspec.cc:4371-4384) is inert in the fixture state (zero params) and in Rugra's FuncProto state today; Rugra's port degrades the loop the same way the in-repo sibling characterize_as_input_param does because ProtoParameter stores a spaceless Address with no standalone size. Lock-state coverage requires the param-space/size storage first.
known_residuals.setinputvarnode_unaffected_derivation: MISMATCH (bank-level, out of scope): Ghidra's Funcdata::setInputVarnode tail (funcdata_varnode.cc:365-371) sets unaffected/return_address from the model effectlist; Rugra's set_input_varnode lacks the tail. The fixture routes around it with register choices (r11 for the spacebase flag, 0xe0 for the equal-address construction) whose input state is otherwise identical; ACTIONDW never reads the unaffected bit.
known_residuals.worklist_order: UNTESTED: the LIFO worklist order is not directly observable through final directwrite flags; only order-independent outcomes are locked.
known_residuals.funcallspecs_possible_input_param: MISMATCH (pre-existing, untouched): FuncCallSpecs::possible_input_param (fspec.rs:2122) remains a model-only delegation without the FuncProto preamble; it is a separate debt from this fixture's FuncProto::possible_input_param.
known_residuals.protorecovery_b_group_filtering: UNTESTED: the decompile-root filtering of the protorecovery_b group is a pipeline-orchestration concern outside ActionDirectWrite::apply.
